name: CRUD Workflow Template
description: A reusable CRUD workflow template that can list, read, create, and update Looker objects.

supported_operations.description: List of operations supported by this instantiation

user_id_limitation.description: Limitation enforcing user ID scoping across CRUD operations

mode.description: 'self' (default) restricts to invoking user ID; 'scope_groups' restricts to user IDs in active scope groups; 'none' applies no user ID scoping

attribute_name.description: User attribute name set on groups for scope group matching (default: 'nano_admin_is_workflow_scope_group')
